+//go:build !scanner
+
+package models
+
+import (
+	"reflect"
+	"testing"
+
+	cvedict "github.com/vulsio/go-cve-dictionary/models"
+)
+
+func TestConvertNvdToModelCvss40(t *testing.T) {
+	contents, _, _ := ConvertNvdToModel("CVE-2024-1234", []cvedict.Nvd{{
+		Cvss2: []cvedict.NvdCvss2Extra{{Source: "nvd@nist.gov", Cvss2: cvedict.Cvss2{BaseScore: 4.3}}},
+		Cvss3: []cvedict.NvdCvss3{{Source: "nvd@nist.gov", Cvss3: cvedict.Cvss3{BaseScore: 7.1}}},
+		Cvss40: []cvedict.NvdCvss40{
+			{Source: "nvd@nist.gov", Cvss40: cvedict.Cvss40{BaseScore: 8.4, VectorString: "CVSS:4.0/NVD", BaseSeverity: "HIGH"}},
+			{Source: "vendor@example.com", Cvss40: cvedict.Cvss40{BaseScore: 5.2, VectorString: "CVSS:4.0/VENDOR", BaseSeverity: "MEDIUM"}},
+		},
+	}})
+
+	if len(contents) != 2 {
+		t.Fatalf("got %d NVD contents, want 2: %+v", len(contents), contents)
+	}
+	bySource := make(map[string]CveContent, len(contents))
+	for _, content := range contents {
+		bySource[content.Optional["source"]] = content
+	}
+	if got := bySource["nvd@nist.gov"]; got.Type != Nvd || got.Cvss2Score != 4.3 || got.Cvss3Score != 7.1 || got.Cvss40Score != 8.4 || got.Cvss40Vector != "CVSS:4.0/NVD" || got.Cvss40Severity != "HIGH" {
+		t.Errorf("NVD source metrics = %+v", got)
+	}
+	if got := bySource["vendor@example.com"]; got.Type != Nvd || got.Cvss40Score != 5.2 || got.Cvss40Vector != "CVSS:4.0/VENDOR" || got.Cvss40Severity != "MEDIUM" || got.Cvss2Score != 0 || got.Cvss3Score != 0 {
+		t.Errorf("vendor source metrics = %+v", got)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestCvss40ScoresMitreThenNvd(t *testing.T) {
+	v := VulnInfo{CveContents: CveContents{
+		Nvd:   {{Type: Nvd, Cvss40Score: 8.4, Cvss40Vector: "CVSS:4.0/NVD", Cvss40Severity: "high"}},
+		Mitre: {{Type: Mitre, Cvss40Score: 5.2, Cvss40Vector: "CVSS:4.0/MITRE", Cvss40Severity: "medium"}},
+	}}
+	want := []CveContentCvss{
+		{Type: Mitre, Value: Cvss{Type: CVSS40, Score: 5.2, Vector: "CVSS:4.0/MITRE", Severity: "MEDIUM"}},
+		{Type: Nvd, Value: Cvss{Type: CVSS40, Score: 8.4, Vector: "CVSS:4.0/NVD", Severity: "HIGH"}},
+	}
+	if got := v.Cvss40Scores(); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
+		t.Errorf("Cvss40Scores() = %+v, want %+v", got, want)
+	}
+}
